tagline: An agent organization for a ten-computer, local-first fabric — five k3s core nodes, five mesh peers, one evidence-led operator. Every department installs independently.

operator.title: The Operator
operator.subtitle: evidence-led human authority
operator.note: Reviewer-class departments report to the Operator, not into the functions they review. Their blocking findings are not overrulable by the department under review — only the Operator may override, and the override is recorded in the decision ledger.

credits: Pattern after cbrock84/headcount (MIT) — departments that install independently, a reviewer class that reports to the top, and a chart generated from the repository tree.

departments.title: Evidence Review
departments.charter: Reviews what the other departments claim to work. Green is not evidence; the artifact is. A check whose passing condition is also satisfied by the failure mode is decoration.

departments.title: Publication Safety
departments.charter: Watches the boundary between the private fabric and every public surface. Synthetic-only in public: no live cluster access, telemetry, identifiers, or operator controls.

departments.title: Office of the Operator
departments.charter: Authority tiers, continuity when the operator is away, and the ledger where decisions and their evidence are recorded — corrections visible, nothing silently rewritten.

departments.title: Fabric
departments.charter: The five-node k3s core. Nodes leave and return with proof; a moving image tag has no rollback target; upgrades go one node at a time with artifact checks between.

departments.title: Mesh
departments.charter: The five peers beyond the core. Keys rotate and the rotation is proven when the old key fails; reachability is read from session artifacts, not a dashboard's green dot.

departments.title: Retrieval
departments.charter: The knowledge fabric: what goes into the corpus, how answers stay grounded and cited, how a query is scoped to the documents it may see, and how replicas stay honest.

departments.title: Workloads
departments.charter: The built public works. Self-contained pages, canaries that earn capabilities one release at a time, and layouts that survive a 320-pixel phone with gloves on.

departments.title: Records
departments.charter: Every claim labeled confirmed, preliminary, or unknown; every figure dated; contradictions flagged in public rather than silently resolved.
